novelty_gap: The student captures the main weighted conformal approach but doesn't fully detail the specific weight functions for different targets (ATE vs ATT vs ATC), the doubly robust property, or the extension from counterfactuals to individual treatment effects. strongest_aspect: Excellent identification of the core problem (covariate shift in counterfactual inference) and the key solution mechanism (weighted conformal prediction with propensity score weights). The student clearly articulates why standard conformal prediction fails and how the treatment assignment mechanism provides the necessary correction.
weakest_aspect: Limited technical depth in the specific algorithmic details and theoretical guarantees.
